explanation.purpose: Adds the cache as its own module first, so the next step only has to wire it in. Expiry is checked on read, which keeps the module free of timers.
assumptions: Expired entries are removed lazily on the next read.

explanation.purpose: The endpoint now asks the cache first and only calls the provider on a miss. The fetch time is stored with the forecast so a cached response reports when its data was actually fetched.
Adds tests that pin the behavior this feature promises: one upstream call for repeated requests, identical response shape for hits and misses, and expiry after the TTL.
assumptions: Tests use a zero-latency mock provider.
